sketch:
Observe: 2D ripple-tank with two zones of different celerities c₁,
c₂ (shallow/deep water analogy). Plane wave crosses interface; λ
shrinks or grows per λ₂/λ₁ = c₂/c₁ and angle changes per
sin(i₁)/sin(i₂) = c₁/c₂. Wavefronts drawn in both zones. Student
sets c₁, c₂, i₁; i₂ HUD. Experiment: 3 seeded target (i₂, λ₂);
student sets c-ratio. Evaluate: refracted wavefronts hidden; only
incident wave and interface; submit c-ratio. Wrinkle: index n
analog is the celerity ratio, tied to Snell.
